to: Mirrors the Node.js [`stream`](https://nodejs.org/api/stream.html) module: the classic `Readable`/`Writable`/`Duplex`/`Transform` classes are backed by [`streamx`](https://github.com/mafintosh/streamx), while `bare-stream/web` provides a `node:stream/web`-compatible implementation of the WHATWG Streams Standard.
